title: Augmentation-preserving shuffle isomorphism for bicosimplicial cochain totalizations
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and use its ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\Delta$ be the category of finite nonempty ordered sets $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n\}$ and order-preserving maps. Let $X:\Delta	imes\Delta	o\operatorname{Ch}^{\geq0}(\mathcal C)$ be a bicosimplicial object in nonnegative cochain complexes. Write $X^{a,b,r}$ for its terms, $d_r$ for its internal differential, and $\delta_1,\delta_2$ for the alternating coface sums in the two cosimplicial directions. All total complexes below have finite sums in each degree, as in [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Define
$$D(X)^m= igoplus_{n+r=m}X^{n,n,r},\qquad d_D=\delta_{\mathrm{diag}}+(-1)^n d_r,$$
where $\delta_{\mathrm{diag}}$ applies each coface in both directions, and
$$T(X)^m= igoplus_{a+b+r=m}X^{a,b,r},\qquad d_T=\delta_1+(-1)^a\delta_2+(-1)^{a+b}d_r.$$
For $a+b=n$, partition $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ into increasing lists $\mu$ of length $a$ and $
u$ of length $b$. Define order-preserving surjections $\alpha_\mu:[n]	o[a]$ and $\alpha_
u:[n]	o[b]$ by $\alpha_\mu(i)=\#\{j\in\mu:j<i\}$ and the corresponding formula for $
u$. Let $\epsilon(\mu,
u)$ be the sign of the permutation whose list is the concatenation $(\mu,
u)$. On $X^{n,n,r}$ define the component into $X^{a,b,r}$ by
$$S_{a,b}=\sum_{\mu\sqcup
u=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\epsilon(\mu,
u)X(\alpha_\mu,\alpha_
u).$$
These components define a natural cochain map $S:D(X)	o T(X)$ which is a chain homotopy equivalence. In particular $S$ specifies a natural isomorphism $D(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(X)$ in $D(\mathcal C)$, not just isomorphisms of individual cohomology objects. If $M$ is a nonnegative complex and $i:M	o X^{0,0, ullet}$ is a chain map with $\delta_1i=\delta_2i=0$, it gives chain maps $j_D:M	o D(X)$ and $j_T:M	o T(X)$ supported in cosimplicial degree zero, and $S j_D=j_T$. This includes constant bicosimplicial objects, vanishing objects, and either cosimplicial direction constant.
